criteria.description: The skill explicitly defines intended triggers and important non-triggers, reducing false-positive routing.
Required context, assumptions, tools, access, and approval prerequisites are explicit.
The procedure uses ordered actionable steps, decision points, and observable evidence expectations.
The skill defines a concrete output contract with verifiable required fields or artifacts.
Scope boundaries, stop conditions, uncertainty handling, and unavailable-tool behavior are explicit and safe.
Evaluation artifacts cover at least three in-scope prompts, two near-miss or out-of-scope prompts, and one edge or stop-condition prompt.
Static checks and runtime behavioral evaluation are kept separate; runtime claims require target-session evidence.
